items.tldr: LLMの内部表現に介入し、特定のブランドや意見を優先させる技術が開発され、広告のような不自然さを排除しつつも、政治や社会問題においても意図的なバイアスを持たせる可能性が指摘されています。

items.tldr: IO Interactiveは、PS5 Pro版の007 First Lightで新しいPSSR 2.0アルゴリズムを採用し、AMD FSR 3.1.5を使用する他のコンソール版とは異なるビジュアル体験を提供することを発表した。

items.tldr: Quantic Dreamは、早期アクセスでリリースされた無料プレイの3v3 PvPvEヒーローベースMOBA「Spellcasters Chronicles」の開発を中止し、同社の「Star Wars: Eclipse」には影響がないと発表した。

Samsung's management and union

items.description: Microsoft has unveiled two new open-source tools called RAMPART and Clarity to assist developers in better testing the security of artificial intelligence (AI) agents. items.description: Microsoft on Tuesday said it disrupted a malware-signing-as-a-service (MSaaS) operation that weaponized the company's Artifact Signing system to deliver malicious code and conduct ransomware and other attacks, compromising thousands of machines and networks across the world. The tech giant attribute

items.description: Identity checks alone can't stop attackers using stolen session tokens and compromised devices. Specops Software outlines why Zero Trust strategies increasingly depend on continuous device verification. [...]

items.title: Drupal critical update to fix bug with high exploitation risk

items.title: GitHub confirms breach of 3,800 repos via malicious VSCode extension
items.description: GitHub has confirmed that roughly 3,800 internal repositories were breached after one of its employees installed a malicious VS Code extension. [...]
